transcription_check.checked_by: Codex translation worker; same-agent review, no independent specialist review
transcription_check.evidence: Individually inspected all 20 Poppler images /tmp/semetey1-volta-0222-0241/page-0222.png through page-0241.png, scale 1600. Read each left column fully then right; classified every running title, folio and printer signature. Preserved exact PDF raw glyphs, bboxes, source IDs and legacy-font-v1 normalization through source_evidence builder. No fixed verse-row assumption. Used primary Kyrgyz/Russian dictionaries and Kyrgyz encyclopedia definitions as lexical aids only; additionally individually inspected alternate Kyrgyz Semetey1 glossary PDF369–375, SHA7ac3f8ee9a8e53f7c633ed5865a58f87cf1fc51399ce0a9c3dd9c67d5c66034a, for exact envoy, booty-division, appeal and guardian readings.
transcription_check.pair_review: All 1551 reconstructed Kyrgyz-English pairs read in order in ten consecutive review blocks (nine blocks of 160, final 111). All 65 revised pairs reread with exact source afterward. Wrapped physical fragments consolidated into source verses; 6 unresolved whole verses excluded from English, with all their source fragments separately preserved. Every repetition retained, including the hostile family account by Ismail, Chubak and Almambet childhoods, campaign and telescope recollections, laments and the racing progress of Taitoru. Differing numbers, ages, time spans and source voice shifts retained.

alignment_check.scope: All source-English pairs and all revised pairs individually read. Final 1545 English verses have unique canonical first-source IDs; grouped fragments and explicit nonverse/unresolved exclusions account for every extraction record on PDF222–241 except20 watermarks.

targeted_qa.details: Audited all 155 included narrative rows on pages 240 and 241; the existing English rows were semantically sound and correctly aligned. Pages 222 through 239 were outside this targeted audit.

publication_basis: New direct model Kyrgyz-to-English translation of traditional epic narrative. No machine-translation API or previous English poem translation used. Kyrgyz/Russian dictionaries and Kyrgyz editorial glosses are lexical aids only; provisional translation and lineation, no expert certification.
